reason: Terminated under the parent order's own termination provision. This order amended the second sentence of Section 1 of Executive Order No. 12358, so its clause continues as part of the parent until the parent ends (owner ruling 2026-10-21, strike-and-insert). Executive Order 12415 of April 5, 1983 (48 FR 15117) amended section 4(b) of Executive Order No. 12358, as amended, to provide that the Commission shall terminate on December 31, 1983, and no held instrument extends it. The Commission, and with it the membership ceiling this order set, therefore had no operation after that date. The date is recorded inclusively as 1983-12-31 (the exclusive reading, ending when that day begins, is the alternative). Executive Order 12415 does not name this order; it is cited because it fixes the termination of the very Commission whose membership this clause governs. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 later revoked this order by number, more than two years after that end; it is the formal disposition and is recorded as a later event, not as the first end.
